name: mixed-local
_comment: Standalone target with --renditions 720p,480p --record: ABR-like quality mix, churn (1 leave + 1 re-join per second), chat for everyone, 10% DVR readers, 10% of the viewers change quality 20 s into each hold, and a separate browser phase (desktop + mobile-like) after stages 10 and 25. Every quality is judged against its own rendition's ingest rate.
